Automation: Rules reference · play automation in progress

You call a short retreat and count the steps, keeping the line together as everyone moves.

Rules

Action
Maneuver
Attribute
None — no roll
Target / range / shape
Two willing allies within 4 squares that can perceive your signal.
Duration
Immediate movement.
Equipment / acquisition
None.
Limits
Repeatable; normal action economy applies.
Type
Signature

Each may move up to 2 squares without provoking, in an order you choose. Each may end farther from or nearer to the fight as needed; no attack is granted. Choose legal routes and free endpoints.

Additional rulings
